plan.goal: Callers need to reserve space for escaped regular-expression text without allocating a temporary string. Add documented public escape_len(pattern: &str) -> usize APIs to the regex and regex-syntax crates. Return the escaped UTF-8 byte length without allocating. Make escaping a nonempty pattern use at most one allocation and empty input none. Preserve escaping results, append behavior, existing APIs and builds without default features. Discover the implementation and integration points from the workspace.
hypotheses: The requested APIs belong in regex-syntax/src/lib.rs and the top-level regex src/lib.rs. regex-syntax already owns the escaping logic: escape calls escape_into, which prefixes each regex metacharacter with one backslash and currently reserves only text.len(), allowing reallocations for escaped inputs. Add documented public escape_len functions that compute text.len() plus the count of metacharacters (each adds one UTF-8 byte), make regex-syntax::escape use String::with_capacity(escape_len(text)), and have regex::escape_len delegate to regex-syntax::escape_len. Empty input then allocates nothing; nonempty escape uses one exact-capacity allocation; escape_into append behavior and existing escaping remain unchanged. The proposed review is syntactically scoped to two files, but compiler/tests and exact allocation behavior remain unverified in discovery.
